# arcane_api_resource (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cluster scoped api resource
resource "arcane_api_resource" "test" {
  manifest = <<-YAML
apiVersion: bluechip.pubg.io/v1
kind: Vendor
metadata:
  name: test-vendor
spec:
  codeName: NCP
  displayName: test
  shortName: dd
  regions:
  - AP-NORTHEAST-222
YAML
}

# Namespace scoped api resource
resource "arcane_api_resource" "test_namespaced" {
  manifest = <<-YAML
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.arcane.pubg.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  annotations:
    foo: bar
  labels: {}
  name: arcane-provider-test
  namespace: default
rules:
- apiGroups:
  - bluechip.pubg.io
  resources:
  - ingameimages
  verbs:
  - '*'
- apiGroups:
  - ""
  resources:
  - namespaces
  verbs:
  - get
  - create
YAML
}
```
